note: Seth Meyers and The Daily Show remain dark through September. Kimmel's slot went to Rosie O'Donnell for a four-night run — her first time back in a late-night host chair in nearly 30 years — while Fallon carried on solo the rest of the week. No official YouTube uploads matched this week's best lines closely enough to link with confidence, so this entry is text-only.

jokes.topic: Opening her four-night run in Kimmel's chair
jokes.joke: If you thought the president hated Jimmy Kimmel Live! when it was hosted by Jimmy Kimmel… buckle up, people. Buckle up.
jokes.context: Followed by explaining she's spent the last two years living in Ireland "because of Mango Mussolini... I read that Project 2025 and said, 'Gotta get myself out of here!' and decided to go to Ireland, where people are driven to drink regardless of who's running their country."

jokes.topic: Closing her guest-hosting run with a Trump-roasting parody of "Danny Boy"
jokes.joke: Oh, Donny boy, it's Rosie, Rosie calling from Hollywood, the Jimmy Kimmel show. Drop that Big Mac that we all know you're holding.
jokes.context: Continued through the whole ballad: "Poor Donny boy, your polls, your polls are falling, your reflecting pool is green as Mountain Dew... your wig's a mess, your ballroom is appalling, and with Iran, you bit off more than you can chew."

jokes.topic: Melania Trump not appearing in public for 29 days
jokes.joke: All I know is that it's going to be crazy when we find out she ran off with Mitch McConnell.
jokes.context: Also got a big audience reaction with: "I haven't seen her in private for two years."

jokes.topic: Trump's friendship with Kim Jong Un and talk of another meeting
jokes.joke: You know you're depressed when you're texting an old hookup from seven years ago.
jokes.context: Said the two "could meet in November," depending on "how their couple's Halloween costume goes."

jokes.topic: Trump's unproven claim that "vandals" damaged the National Mall grass and Reflecting Pool
jokes.joke: These are tough times for Trump. The grass is brown. The Reflecting Pool is green. And the bruise on his hand is blue.
jokes.context: Followed with a hair joke riffing on the same "cover it up" logic: "He's gonna let the healthy grass grow long and then rake it over to the bare spot. Just cover it. You comb it right over."
